gaps.sentence: The thief was sent to ___ prison for three years.
gaps.explanation: 'Sent to prison' — the institution, no article; 'the prison' would mean the building.
Plural general nouns and flu (illness name) take no article.

gaps.sentence: He was offered ___ job in the human resources department.
gaps.explanation: 'A job' — first mention of one of many possible jobs. Note: 'in human resources' takes no article.

gaps.sentence: They moved to ___ coastal town an hour south of the capital.
gaps.explanation: A coastal town — first mention of one of many.

gaps.sentence: They elected her ___ chairperson for a second term.
gaps.explanation: After 'elect/appoint', roles take no article: elected her chairperson.

gaps.sentence: The kids spent ___ afternoon playing in the garden.
gaps.explanation: 'The afternoon' and 'the garden' (our garden) are definite in context.

gaps.sentence: The train arrived ___ hour late because of signal failure.
gaps.explanation: 'Hour' begins with a silent h, so the vowel form 'an' is required.

gaps.sentence: These apples cost two euros ___ kilo.
gaps.explanation: 'A/per' is used for rates: two euros a kilo, twice a week, 60 km an hour.
